fieldValues.title: A reader cannot follow an essay to what it rests on
fieldValues.statement: A quote should be able to reveal its source, and a statement should be able to point to a reference document or an external url. A paragraph may link to problems and claims, and I may want to browse the background or see a list of citations. Today, in a read-only essay, the page and the References panel do not respond to clicks, so I can see that a paragraph has something attached but cannot open it. Exported, the references are a separate file. I have to take the essay's evidence on trust, in a form of writing whose point is that the evidence can be checked.
